findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "watch_routes" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_fees, my_effective_rate, watch_routes · Private data: get_fees, watch_routes, route_it_for_me · Public sink: compare_send_money, my_effective_rate, report_observed_fee, watch_routes, route_it_for_me.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_fees, my_effective_rate, watch_routes · Private data: get_fees, watch_routes, route_it_for_me · Public sink: compare_send_money, my_effective_rate, report_observed_fee, watch_routes, route_it_for_me

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
